description: Seven-character annual-file ORIs whose nine-character Historical identity cannot be derived by padding or by a unique prefix. Each mapping is checked against the agency directory before any data is loaded: the target must exist, sit in the stated state, and carry a compatible name. A mapping that disagrees stops the build.
provenance: Transcribed from the ORI_MAP in the untracked reference scripts/import_reta_2025.py and re-validated against geographies.csv. Pontiac is the mapping that matters most: without it, the annual year prefix-matches the predecessor ORI that the consolidation step then removes, and the year is lost.

mappings.evidence: geographies.csv lists IN0494900 as "Indianapolis" in IN; INIPD0000 is the Unigov identifier for the same department
geographies.csv lists MI6367300 as "Pontiac" in MI and it is the survivor of the MI631900X consolidation
geographies.csv lists MI6331400 as "Independence Township" in MI
